title: Meaning, facts, permission and execution stay separate
summary: Management discovers what specialists can answer. Domain objects own facts, Intention providers own meaning, policy owns permission, and domain authorities own execution semantics. Recognition and presentation never imply authority.
invariants: LLM or deterministic intention recognition supplies meaning, not operational authority.
Instrumentation and observations are evidence, never mutation authority.
Mutation must continue through the normal Intention Service confirmation/READY/COMMIT and domain policy path.
Management owns no provider credentials, cloud CLI syntax, raw network probing, host shell or transport acquisition.
ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL / alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 is the current cloud RESOURCE/NODE authority; Management may discover and bind it but does not absorb it.
ooRexx Cloud Console is a human/code/Codex interaction facade over cloud authority; it does not become capability truth merely because it can render plans or invoke an adapter.
cloudctl.sh and sshnode.sh are convenience/qualification/emergency shortcuts only; they are not semantic APIs or capability registries.
A workspace or source path is execution context, not permission, durable state authority or semantic identity.
Native controls are implementation details; authoritative Alchemy/domain objects are the public system.

provenance.claim: Architecture guard rejects cloud/provider shortcut execution knowledge from Management source/tests.
Read-only instrumentation intention surface deliberately excludes Instrumentation Mesh command envelopes.
Development Floor pins alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 and registers ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL for RESOURCE/NODE operations.
Qualified interaction facade with provider-neutral vocabulary, plan/apply fencing, workspace-safe Codex transport and fake-provider tests; no live-cloud mutation qualification.
